blocks.html:
Screen Printing for Black Forest's Rural Colorado Community

Black Forest is a large rural community in northern El Paso County — about 15,000 residents spread across custom homes, horse properties, and ponderosa pine forests northeast of Colorado Springs. It's a community defined by its love of open space, equestrian culture, and tight-knit neighborhood associations. The Black Forest Fire of 2013 forged an especially strong sense of community resilience and mutual support. Custom apparel for neighborhood associations, equestrian groups, volunteer fire stations, and community events is a natural fit here.

Black Forest falls primarily within Academy School District 20 (D20), one of the highest-rated school districts in Colorado. Students often attend Pine Creek High School and other D20 programs, all of which have active athletic departments and booster organizations. Local small businesses — from equestrian supply to landscaping and custom construction — also need branded workwear and event apparel. We're about 20 miles southwest in Colorado Springs and ship directly to the Black Forest area.
